rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an open platform projecting from a building.

example.english: Our flat's terrace faces the sea, so it's convenient for hanging laundry.
example.traditional: 我哋屋企個露台向海，晾衫好方便。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 go3 lou6 toi4 hoeng3 hoi2 long6 saam1 hou2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this for a flat open area on the roof or top of a building rather than a projecting platform.

example.english: We went up to the roof terrace to look at the stars.
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 ngo5 dei6 soeng5 tin1 toi4 tai2 sing1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a continuous row or group of adjoining residential houses.

example.english: A row of terrace houses was newly built in that area, and each one has a small garden.
example.traditional: 嗰區新起咗一排排屋，間間都有小花園。
example.jyutping: go2 keoi1 san1 hei2 zo2 jat1 paai4 paai4 uk1 gaan1 gaan1 dou1 jau5 siu2 faa1 jyun2
